---
title: "Minimum unit pricing: figures and tables"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)
```

# 00. SETUP

```{r}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Statistics
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# Tables and figures
library(patchwork)

# Options
options(scipen = 999)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
            theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fcfcfb", colour = NA),
                  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fcfcfb", colour = NA),
                  legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank()))
col_observed <- "#2a78d6"
col_counterfactual <- "#eb6834"
results <- readRDS("results.rds")
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# F1. OBSERVED VS COUNTERFACTUAL PER JURISDICTION

```{r}
################################################################################
# F1. Observed vs counterfactual
################################################################################

# Scotland (primary CITS 2012-2024, control England)
f1_scotland <- results$h0_df_main %>%
  mutate(counterfactual = England * exp(predict(results$h0_model_main, newdata = mutate(results$h0_df_main, mup = 0)))) %>%
  select(year, Observed = Scotland, Counterfactual = counterfactual) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Scotland (MUP May 2018) vs England")

# Wales (primary CITS 2012-2024, control England)
f1_wales <- results$h3_df %>%
  mutate(counterfactual = England * exp(predict(results$h3_model_main, newdata = mutate(results$h3_df, mup = 0)))) %>%
  select(year, Observed = Wales, Counterfactual = counterfactual) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Wales (MUP Mar 2020) vs England")

# Ireland (primary CITS 2012-2024, control Northern Ireland)
f1_ireland <- results$h4_df %>%
  mutate(counterfactual = `Northern Ireland` * exp(predict(results$h4_model_ni, newdata = mutate(results$h4_df, mup = 0)))) %>%
  select(year, Observed = Ireland, Counterfactual = counterfactual) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Ireland (MUP Jan 2022) vs Northern Ireland")

f1_df <- bind_rows(f1_scotland, f1_wales, f1_ireland) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = factor(jurisdiction, levels = unique(jurisdiction)),
         name = factor(name, levels = c("Observed", "Counterfactual")))
f1_starts <- tibble(jurisdiction = factor(levels(f1_df$jurisdiction), levels = levels(f1_df$jurisdiction)), start = c(2018 + 4 / 12, 2020 + 2 / 12, 2022))

h1_figure_counterfactual <- ggplot(f1_df, aes(year, value, colour = name, linetype = name)) +
  geom_vline(data = f1_starts, aes(xintercept = start), colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2019.9, xmax = 2021.9, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ jurisdiction, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = col_observed, Counterfactual = col_counterfactual)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Observed = "solid", Counterfactual = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Alcohol-specific deaths per 100,000 (ESP2013)",
       caption = "Counterfactual = control rate x fitted gap without the MUP term (CITS, Newey-West).\nGrey band = 2020-21 (COVID term). Ireland: proxy definition F10+K70+X45+X65+Y15.")
print(h1_figure_counterfactual)

# Northern Territory (secondary; counts, vs all other states)
f1_nt <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "australia") %>%
  filter(year <= 2024) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(others = sum(deaths) - deaths) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(state == "Northern Territory") %>%
  mutate(Counterfactual = others * exp(coef(results$s3_model_nt)["(Intercept)"])) %>%
  select(year, Observed = deaths, Counterfactual) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year)
h1_figure_nt <- ggplot(f1_nt, aes(year, value, colour = name, linetype = name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2018.75, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = col_observed, Counterfactual = col_counterfactual)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Observed = "solid", Counterfactual = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Alcohol-induced deaths (count)",
       title = "Northern Territory floor price (Oct 2018) - confounded, secondary",
       caption = "Counterfactual = other states' deaths x pre-period ratio (2016-17).\nCo-policies: Banned Drinker Register (Sep 2017), PALIs (Oct 2018). Floor price repealed 1 Mar 2025.")
print(h1_figure_nt)
```

# F2. FOREST PLOT

```{r}
################################################################################
# F2. Forest plot
################################################################################

f2_df <- tribble(
  ~label, ~group, ~b, ~lo, ~hi,
  "Published: Wyper et al. 2023 (2012-2020)", "Scotland 2018", log(1 - 0.134), log(1 - 0.184), log(1 - 0.083),
  "Scotland, Wyper-matched window 2012-2020", "Scotland 2018",
    coef(results$h0_model_wyper)["mup"],
    coefci(results$h0_model_wyper, vcov = results$h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(results$h0_model_wyper))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$h0_model_wyper, vcov = results$h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(results$h0_model_wyper))["mup", 2],
  "Scotland, primary 2012-2024", "Scotland 2018",
    coef(results$h0_model_main)["mup"],
    coefci(results$h0_model_main, vcov = results$h0_vcov_main, df = df.residual(results$h0_model_main))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$h0_model_main, vcov = results$h0_vcov_main, df = df.residual(results$h0_model_main))["mup", 2],
  "Scotland, pre-trend-only projection", "Scotland 2018",
    results$h0_slope_avg$estimate, log(1 + results$h0_slope_avg$lcl_pct / 100), log(1 + results$h0_slope_avg$ucl_pct / 100),
  "Wales, primary 2012-2024", "Replication",
    coef(results$h3_model_main)["mup"],
    coefci(results$h3_model_main, vcov = results$h3_vcov_main, df = df.residual(results$h3_model_main))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$h3_model_main, vcov = results$h3_vcov_main, df = df.residual(results$h3_model_main))["mup", 2],
  "Ireland vs Northern Ireland", "Replication",
    coef(results$h4_model_ni)["mup"],
    coefci(results$h4_model_ni, vcov = results$h4_vcov_ni, df = df.residual(results$h4_model_ni))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$h4_model_ni, vcov = results$h4_vcov_ni, df = df.residual(results$h4_model_ni))["mup", 2],
  "Ireland vs England", "Replication",
    coef(results$h4_model_eng)["mup"],
    coefci(results$h4_model_eng, vcov = results$h4_vcov_eng, df = df.residual(results$h4_model_eng))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$h4_model_eng, vcov = results$h4_vcov_eng, df = df.residual(results$h4_model_eng))["mup", 2],
  "Pooled random effects (Scotland, Wales, Ireland vs NI)", "Pooled",
    as.numeric(results$h5_model_pooled$b), results$h5_model_pooled$ci.lb, results$h5_model_pooled$ci.ub,
  "Northern Territory vs other states (confounded)", "Secondary",
    coef(results$s3_model_nt)["mup"],
    coefci(results$s3_model_nt, vcov = results$s3_vcov_nt, df = df.residual(results$s3_model_nt))["mup", 1],
    coefci(results$s3_model_nt, vcov = results$s3_vcov_nt, df = df.residual(results$s3_model_nt))["mup", 2]
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(b, lo, hi), ~ 100 * (exp(.x) - 1)),
         label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Scotland 2018", "Replication", "Pooled", "Secondary")),
         text = sprintf("%+.1f%% (%+.1f to %+.1f)", b, lo, hi))
print(f2_df)

h2_figure_forest <- ggplot(f2_df, aes(b, label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0.25, colour = col_observed, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = group == "Pooled"), size = 3, colour = col_observed) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 190, label = text), hjust = 1, size = 3.3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-65, 190)) +
  labs(x = "% change in alcohol-specific death rate vs counterfactual (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       caption = "CITS on log rate ratio, Newey-West SE, t-based CI. Scotland's published estimate shown for reference (not pooled).") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
print(h2_figure_forest)
```

# F3. SCOTLAND 50P -> 65P DOSE PLOT

```{r}
################################################################################
# F3. Dose plot
################################################################################

f3_df <- results$h6_monthly %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2018-05-01")) %>%
  mutate(fitted = exp(predict(results$h6_model_monthly, newdata = .)),
         no_65p = exp(predict(results$h6_model_monthly, newdata = mutate(., step_65p = 0))))

h3_figure_dose <- ggplot(f3_df, aes(date)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2020-03-01"), xmax = as.Date("2021-12-31"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-10-01"), colour = "grey30", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-01-01"), colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-10-01"), y = 33, label = "65p (30 Sep 2024)", hjust = -0.05, size = 3.3) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-01"), y = 31, label = "placebo Jan 2024", hjust = 1.05, size = 3.3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(y = rate), colour = "grey55", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = no_65p, colour = "Projected without 65p step"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted, colour = "Fitted (with 65p step)"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Fitted (with 65p step)` = col_observed, `Projected without 65p step` = col_counterfactual)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Monthly alcohol-specific ASMR per 100,000",
       title = "Scotland: alcohol-specific deaths, May 2018 - Dec 2025 (15 months after 65p)",
       caption = "Uncontrolled ITS (trend + month + COVID). The same model gives -11% at a placebo step in Jan 2024,\nand England fell 8% in 2024: the decline is not attributable to 65p. Grey points = observed (NRS).")
print(h3_figure_dose)
```

# F5. FIRST STAGE

```{r}
################################################################################
# F5. First stage
################################################################################

h5_figure_below50p <- ggplot(results$h1_price %>% mutate(country = recode(country, "Eng&Wales" = "England & Wales")),
                             aes(year, pct_below_50p, colour = country)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2018 + 4 / 12, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Scotland = col_observed, `England & Wales` = col_counterfactual)) +

       caption = "PHS MESAS 2022 price-band tables (excl. discount retailers).")

                                  aes(year, litres_per_capita_15plus)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +

print(h5_figure_first_stage)
```

# F6. MULTIVERSE SPECIFICATION CURVE (H8, ALL ALCOHOL-SPECIFIC DEATHS)

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 9}
################################################################################
# F6. Specification curve
################################################################################

f6_df <- results$h8_multiverse$cits %>%
  filter(!dropped) %>%
  arrange(effect_pct) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(),
         highlight = if_else(wyper, "Wyper-matched (2012-2020, England, full trend)", "Other specification"))

h6_figure_curve_top <- ggplot(f6_df, aes(rank, effect_pct)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -13.4, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = -13.4, label = "published -13.4%", vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0, size = 3.2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lcl_pct, ymax = ucl_pct), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = highlight, size = highlight)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Other specification` = col_observed,
                                 `Wyper-matched (2012-2020, England, full trend)` = col_counterfactual)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`Other specification` = 0.9, `Wyper-matched (2012-2020, England, full trend)` = 3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% change vs counterfactual (95% CI)",
       title = sprintf("Scotland 2018 vs control: %d CITS specifications", nrow(f6_df))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

f6_indicators <- f6_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(start, end), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(start, end, trend, control, covid), names_to = "dimension", values_to = "level") %>%
  mutate(dimension = factor(dimension, levels = c("start", "end", "trend", "control", "covid")))

h6_figure_curve_bottom <- ggplot(f6_indicators, aes(rank, level)) +
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 0.7, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_grid(dimension ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Specifications, sorted by estimate", y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92"))

h6_figure_curve <- h6_figure_curve_top / h6_figure_curve_bottom + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.3))
print(h6_figure_curve)
```

# F7. CAUSE-SPECIFIC SPLIT (H9)

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
################################################################################
# F7. Cause-specific estimates and multiverse
################################################################################

f7_labels <- c(k70 = "Alcoholic liver disease (K70)", f10 = "Mental/behavioural, alcohol (F10)",
               poisoning = "Acute poisoning (X45+X65+Y15)")

f7_primary <- results$h9_cause$table %>%
  select(cause, effect_pct, lcl_pct, ucl_pct, mde_pct) %>%
  mutate(window = "Primary 2012-2024") %>%
  bind_rows(results$h9_cause$table %>%
              transmute(cause, effect_pct = effect_wyper_pct, lcl_pct = lcl_wyper_pct, ucl_pct = ucl_wyper_pct,
                        mde_pct, window = "Wyper window 2012-2020")) %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(f7_labels[cause], levels = rev(f7_labels)))

h7_figure_cause_forest <- ggplot(f7_primary, aes(effect_pct, cause, colour = window)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lcl_pct, xmax = ucl_pct), height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Primary 2012-2024` = col_observed, `Wyper window 2012-2020` = col_counterfactual)) +
  labs(x = "% change vs counterfactual (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Scotland vs England by underlying cause (crude rates)",
       caption = "All three causes underpowered (MDE: K70 15%, F10 57%, poisoning 33%). Holm-adjusted p = 1 for all primary tests.")

f7_curve <- results$h9_cause$multiverse %>%
  filter(!dropped) %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  arrange(effect_pct, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(f7_labels[cause], levels = f7_labels),
         window_start = if_else(start >= 2011, "Start 2011-2014", "Start 2007-2010 (spans 2011 coding change)"))

h7_figure_cause_curve <- ggplot(f7_curve, aes(rank, effect_pct, colour = window_start)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ cause, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Start 2011-2014` = col_observed, `Start 2007-2010 (spans 2011 coding change)` = "grey70")) +
  labs(x = "Specifications, sorted by estimate", y = "% change vs counterfactual",
       title = "Cause-specific multiverse (CITS, crude rates)",
       caption = "Poisoning specs including 2007-2008 dropped (zero Scottish deaths: X45 coding began 2011).") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

h7_figure_cause <- h7_figure_cause_forest / h7_figure_cause_curve + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2.2))
print(h7_figure_cause)
```
